Zoe (CS): Heads-up — Oxford preview (wave G) can't accept invites due to SAML attribute mismatch. PM worried about timelines; renewal flagged as 'watch' if onboarding slips >9 days.
Miguel (Enablement): can we do a 15m 'unblock sprint' to get them running with a temporary token and demo core flows?
Rae (SolutionsEng): 15m works. i'll need the SAML error screenshot and their IdP metadata beforehand. asked last week, no response.
Zoe (CS): i'll ping the PM right now and offer the temp-token option as mitigation.
onboard-bot: Temp token created: https://redwood.example/tokens/oxford-temp-9a - expires 2024-07-20T12:00Z. Audit logging on.
Miguel (Enablement): i'll prep a 1-slide quickstart and a 1-question pulse: "Can you run your top-3 flows? yes/no" to capture immediate signal.
Rae (SolutionsEng): also prepare a tiny rollback plan: revoke token -> reprovision sandbox. recommend small-llm-fast for staging to keep latency low.
Zoe (CS): onboard-bot, please create invite for Fri 2024-07-12 10:00 UTC - attendees: Zoe (CS), Miguel (Enablement), Rae (SolutionsEng), Oxford PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Fri 2024-07-12 10:00 UTC - "Oxford wave G: rapid unblock (15m)" - join link: https://meet.redwood/example/oxg
Miguel (Enablement): agenda: 1) quick SAML triage (4m), 2) temp token walkthrough (6m), 3) run 3 flows + pulse (5m).
Zoe (CS): next steps: 1) Zoe nudge PM for screenshot/IdP metadata (ASAP). 2) Miguel finalize slide + pulse (Thu EOD). 3) Rae prepare rollback + model note (Thu EOD). I'll log as renewal touch for AM.
Rae (SolutionsEng): ack.
Miguel (Enablement): ack.
Zoe (CS): thanks team — ping if PM uploads artifacts and i'll forward. :thumbsup:
